description.description: Complete replacement description; use empty text to clear the description. Omission and null are not accepted.

items.description: Dataset name derived by Axiom from the replacement query.

description.description: Resulting description; omitted if Axiom omits empty metadata.

sharedByOrgId.description: Provider-returned sharing organization ID; omitted when absent.

sharedByOrgName.description: Provider-returned sharing organization name; omitted when absent.

version.description: Expected current version for an existing dashboard; omit when creating a UID known to be absent.

dashboardUid.description: Organization-scoped unique UID used as the exact match key.

charts.description: Complete chart configurations with IDs and type-specific query/content; [] removes all charts.

layout.description: Complete chart grid layouts; [] removes all layout entries.

ownerId.description: Owner user ID or X-AXIOM-EVERYONE for organization-wide access.

settings.description: Additional domain settings such as sections; omitted settings are removed. Reserved modeled keys, uid, and schemaVersion are disallowed.

comparison.description: Comparison choice; omission removes the prior comparison.

timestamp.description: Explicit-offset RFC3339 instant exact to milliseconds, now-duration expression, or empty to disable.

relativeOffset.description: Relative comparison offset; empty disables comparison.

end.description: Explicit-offset RFC3339 instant exact to milliseconds, or qr-now.

start.description: Explicit-offset RFC3339 instant exact to milliseconds, or qr-now-duration expression.

timeWindow.description: Complete dashboard range, preserving absolute or rolling meaning.

description.description: Explanation; omission removes prior description on replacement.

refreshIntervalSeconds.description: Refresh period in seconds; omission resets to zero, disabling refresh.

configuration.description: Complete replacement content, not a partial patch.

overwritten.description: Provider overwrite indicator, only if returned.
